answer: A concrete rule the ledger can enforce: let the challenge probing adapt: it keeps issuing tasks the fleet already failed, because ripple only stays cheap while repeat infrastructure gets no useful signal and its pass rate degrades each epoch. Concretely, gale is enforced in the ledger: Every gate is public and recomputable, so honest agents can verify they were treated fairly. Any harbor approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. Which means a farm's marginal clone is worth less than nothing.
